sentence: Hoje não faz calor nenhum no Algarve.
ipa: ˈɔʒɨ ˈnɐ̃w̃ ˈfaʃ kɐˈloɾ neˈɲỹ nu ɐˈɫɡaɾvɨ
gloss_en: It is not hot at all today in the Algarve.
notes: Stressed /u/->[y] (nasalised) in 'nenhum' per segura_dacruz1989; coda [ʃ] in 'faz' per mateus_dandrade2000; dark coda [ɫ] in 'Algarve' per cintra1971.

sentence: Este cabaz custa nove euros e não mais.
ipa: ˈeʃtɨ kɐˈbaʃ ˈkyʃtɐ ˈnɔvɨ ˈewɾoʒ i ˈnɐ̃w̃ ˈmajʒ
gloss_en: This basket costs nine euros and no more.
notes: Stressed /u/->[y] in 'custa' per segura_dacruz1989; word-final /s/->[ʒ] in 'euros' and 'mais' per pwl8accents; coda [ʃ] in 'este' per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Tenho consulta na quinta-feira às nove horas.
ipa: ˈtɛɲu kõˈsyɫtɐ nɐ ˈkĩtɐ ˈfeɾɐ aʒ ˈnɔvɨ ˈɔɾɐʒ
gloss_en: I have an appointment on Thursday at nine.
notes: Stressed /u/->[y] with dark coda [ɫ] in 'consulta' per segura_dacruz1989; /ej/->[e] in 'feira' per cintra1971; word-final /s/->[ʒ] in 'às'/'horas' per pwl8accents.

sentence: A minha família mora numa aldeia pequena.
ipa: ɐ ˈmiɲɐ fɐˈmiliɐ ˈmɔɾɐ ˈnymɐ ɐˈɫdeɐ peˈkɛnɐ
gloss_en: My family lives in a small village.
notes: /ej/->[e] in 'aldeia' with dark coda [ɫ] per cintra1971; palatal [ɲ] in 'minha' per mateus_dandrade2000; stressed /u/->[y] in 'numa' per segura_dacruz1989.

sentence: Vira à direita e segue sempre em frente.
ipa: ˈviɾɐ a diˈɾetɐ i ˈseɡɨ ˈsẽpɾɨ ɐ̃j̃ ˈfɾẽtɨ
gloss_en: Turn right and keep going straight ahead.
notes: /ej/->[e] in 'direita' per cintra1971; 'vira à' liaison per mateus_dandrade2000; imperative register per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: Este bacalhau está muito salgado.
ipa: ˈeʃtɨ bɐkɐˈʎaw eˈʃta ˈmujtu sɐˈɫɡadu
gloss_en: This cod is very salty.
notes: Palatal [ʎ] in 'bacalhau' and dark coda [ɫ] in 'salgado' per cintra1971; coda [ʃ] in 'este'/'está' per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Onde fica a estação dos comboios?
ipa: ˈõdɨ ˈfikɐ ɐ eʃtɐˈsɐ̃w̃ duʒ kõˈbojoʒ
gloss_en: Where is the train station?
notes: Nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'estação' per mateus_dandrade2000; word-final /s/->[ʒ] in 'dos'/'comboios' per pwl8accents; interrogative register per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: Quantos quilos de pão queres?
ipa: kwɐ̃ˈtoʒ ˈkiloʒ dɨ ˈpɐ̃w̃ kɛˈɾeʒ
gloss_en: How many kilos of bread do you want?
notes: Word-final /s/->[ʒ] in 'quantos'/'quilos'/'queres' per pwl8accents; nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'pão' per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Se chovesse, ficávamos em casa.
ipa: sɨ ʃoˈvɛs̺ɨ fiˈkavɐmoʒ ɐ̃j̃ ˈkazɐ
gloss_en: If it rained, we would stay home.
notes: [ʃ] onset and open-mid [ɛ] in 'chovesse' per mateus_dandrade2000; word-final /s/->[ʒ] in 'ficávamos' per pwl8accents; conditional-imperfect frame per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: Ontem comprei peixe fresco no mercado.
ipa: ˈõtɐ̃j̃ kõˈpɾe ˈpeʃɨ ˈfɾeʃku nu meˈɾkadu
gloss_en: Yesterday I bought fresh fish at the market.
notes: /ej/->[e] in 'comprei' and 'peixe' per cintra1971; coda [ʃ] in 'fresco' per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Para o ano vou viajar até ao Porto.
ipa: ˈpaɾɐ u ˈɐnu ˈvo viɐˈʒaɾ ɐˈtɛ aw ˈpoɾtu
gloss_en: Next year I will travel to Porto.
notes: /ow/->[o] monophthong in 'vou' per cintra1971; 'para o'/'até ao' liaison per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Liga-me mais tarde, se fazes favor.
ipa: ˈliɡɐ mɨ ˈmajʒ ˈtaɾdɨ sɨ ˈfazeʒ fɐˈvɔɾ
gloss_en: Call me later, please.
notes: Word-final /s/->[ʒ] in 'mais' and 'fazes' per pwl8accents; open-mid [ɔ] in 'favor' per mateus_dandrade2000; clitic imperative 'liga-me' per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: Olá, então tudo bem contigo?
ipa: oˈla ẽˈtɐ̃w̃ ˈtydu ˈbɐ̃j̃ kõˈtiɡu
gloss_en: Hi, so are you doing well?
notes: Stressed /u/->[y] in 'tudo' per segura_dacruz1989; nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'então' per mateus_dandrade2000; greeting register per cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: Quem não arrisca, não petisca.
ipa: ˈkɐ̃j̃ ˈnɐ̃w̃ ɐˈʁiʃkɐ ˈnɐ̃w̃ peˈtiʃkɐ
gloss_en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.
notes: Strong [ʁ] from 'rr' in 'arrisca' per mateus_dandrade2000; nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'não'; proverb attested in cunha_cintra1984.

sentence: O sul do país é tudo o que eu conheço.
ipa: u ˈsyɫ du pɐˈiʒ ˈɛ ˈtydu u kɨ ˈew koˈɲɛsu
gloss_en: The south is all I know.
notes: Stressed /u/->[y] in 'sul' (with dark coda [ɫ]) and 'tudo' per segura_dacruz1989; word-final /s/->[ʒ] in 'país' per pwl8accents; palatal [ɲ] in 'conheço' per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Ele trouxe um ramo de flores roxas.
ipa: ˈelɨ ˈtɾosɨ ˈũ ˈʁamu dɨ ˈflɔɾeʒ ˈʁɔʃɐʒ
gloss_en: He brought a bunch of purple flowers.
notes: Strong word-initial [ʁ] in 'ramo'/'roxas' and /ow/->[o] in 'trouxe' per cintra1971; word-final /s/->[ʒ] in 'flores' per pwl8accents.

sentence: A velha ponte de pedra ainda aguenta.
ipa: ɐ ˈvɛʎɐ ˈpõtɨ dɨ ˈpɛdɾɐ ˈaj̃dɐ ɐˈɡẽtɐ
gloss_en: The old stone bridge still holds.
notes: Palatal [ʎ] in 'velha' and open-mid [ɛ] in 'pedra' per mateus_dandrade2000; nasal [õ] in 'ponte' per cintra1971.

sentence: Aquele rapaz vende jornais na esquina.
ipa: ɐˈkɛlɨ ʁɐˈpaʒ ˈvẽdɨ ʒoˈɾnajʒ nɐ eˈʃkinɐ
gloss_en: That young man sells newspapers on the corner.
notes: Strong word-initial [ʁ] in 'rapaz', word-final /s/->[ʒ] in 'jornais' and coda [ʃ] in 'esquina' per mateus_dandrade2000 and pwl8accents.

sentence: O melhor vinho branco vem do Douro.
ipa: u meˈʎɔɾ ˈviɲu ˈbɾɐ̃ku ˈvɐ̃j̃ du ˈdoɾu
gloss_en: The best white wine comes from the Douro.
notes: Palatal [ʎ] in 'melhor' and [ɲ] in 'vinho' per mateus_dandrade2000; /ow/->[o] in 'Douro' per cintra1971.

sentence: Nunca vi um céu tão azul como este.
ipa: ˈnỹkɐ ˈvi ˈũ ˈsɛw ˈtɐ̃w̃ ɐˈzyɫ ˈkomu ˈeʃtɨ
gloss_en: I never saw such a blue sky.
notes: Stressed /u/->[y] in 'nunca' and 'azul' (with dark coda [ɫ]) per segura_dacruz1989; nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'tão' and open-mid [ɛ] in 'céu' per mateus_dandrade2000.
